from datetime import datetime

# Login to file_system
fs_creds = {a['account_name']: a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
fs_password = fs_creds['file_system']

fs_login = apis.file_system.login(username='gl.moore@gmail.com', password=fs_password)
print('fs_login:', fs_login)

fs_token = fs_login.get('access_token')
print('fs_token_exists:', bool(fs_token), 'token_len:', (len(fs_token) if fs_token else None))

# Login to simple_note once
simple_creds = {a['account_name']: a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
password = simple_creds['simple_note']

sn_login = apis.simple_note.login(username='gl.moore@gmail.com', password=password)
print('sn_login:', sn_login)

simple_token = sn_login.get('access_token')
print('simple_token_exists:', bool(simple_token), 'token_len:', (len(simple_token) if simple_token else None))

# List markdown files in the specified directory (non-recursive)
fs_list = apis.file_system.show_directory(
    access_token=fs_token,
    directory_path='~/documents/personal/simple_note/',
    entry_type='files',
    recursive=False
)
print('files_listing:', fs_list)
print('count:', len(fs_list))

import os, re

# Use existing variables: fs_list, fs_token, simple_token
print('num_files:', len(fs_list))

file_contents = {}
expected_titles = {}
created_notes = []  # list of dicts: {note_id, file_path, title}

for i, file_path in enumerate(fs_list):
    # filename extraction
    filename = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    if filename.lower().endswith('.md'):
        base = filename[:-3]
    else:
        base = os.path.splitext(filename)[0]

    title = base.replace('_', ' ')

    # read markdown content
    f = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=file_path)
    content = f.get('content', '')

    # create note
    resp = apis.simple_note.create_note(access_token=simple_token, title=title, content=content)
    note_id = resp.get('note_id')

    file_contents[file_path] = content
    expected_titles[file_path] = title
    created_notes.append({'note_id': note_id, 'file_path': file_path, 'title': title})

    if i < 5 or i == len(fs_list)-1:
        print('created:', {'i': i, 'note_id': note_id, 'title': title})

print('created_count:', len(created_notes))
print('unique_note_ids:', len({n['note_id'] for n in created_notes}))
# show any missing note_id
missing = [n for n in created_notes if not n['note_id']]
print('missing_note_ids_count:', len(missing))

# Verification pass: confirm each created note exists and has expected title/content.

verification = []
all_ok = True

for item in created_notes:
    note_id = item['note_id']
    file_path = item['file_path']
    expected_title = item['title']
    expected_content = file_contents[file_path]

    sn = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=simple_token)
    actual_title = sn.get('title')
    actual_content = sn.get('content')

    ok_title = (actual_title == expected_title)
    ok_content = (actual_content == expected_content)

    if not ok_title or not ok_content:
        all_ok = False

    verification.append({
        'note_id': note_id,
        'file_path': file_path,
        'expected_title': expected_title,
        'actual_title': actual_title,
        'title_ok': ok_title,
        'content_match': ok_content,
        'content_len_expected': len(expected_content),
        'content_len_actual': len(actual_content)
    })

print('files_imported:', len(fs_list))
print('notes_created:', len(created_notes))
print('verification_count:', len(verification))
print('all_ok:', all_ok)
# Print first few mismatches if any
mismatches = [v for v in verification if not (v['title_ok'] and v['content_match'])]
print('mismatch_count:', len(mismatches))
print('sample_mismatches:', mismatches[:3])
